_doc: Network-layer egress allowlist for the egress sidecar (docker-compose.egress.yml, docs/EGRESS.md). Enforced in-kernel: DNS names not allowed here get NXDOMAIN; IPs not resolved through an allowed name are DROPPED. Copy to the deployment ROOT as ./egress-policy.json (never into ./home — the agent owns home rw and must not author its own policy). Changes require an egress-sidecar restart. Unknown JSON keys (like these _doc/comment fields) are ignored by the sidecar.
_policy: MINIMAL BY DEFAULT — same stance as the guard's policies/default-egress.json: model APIs, packages, source, images, and the operator's host bridges. Anything task-specific is deliberately absent; add per-agent entries when the agent's mission needs them. Wildcards do NOT match the apex (*.anthropic.com does not cover anthropic.com) and DO span subdomain dots — never allow a wildcard whose subdomains are attacker-nameable (the *.amazonaws.com lesson: evil-bucket.s3.amazonaws.com).

egress.comment: host bridges via host.docker.internal on Docker Desktop (qmd/comms/voice/transcribe). On Linux use 172.17.0.1/32 instead.
